name: convo-direct-slug-for-uuid-masked
description: Direct (MCP) tool path: a draft tool whose lookup receives a workflow slug where the uuid column expects an id fails inside PostgreSQL. The caller and the persisted tool call see one clean `tool_execution_failed` envelope with a directly invocable recovery, never the SQL text, its parameters or the driver message.
failure_class: slug passed where a uuid is expected leaks SQL on the direct path
